fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Pakistan requires your passport to expire at least 6 months after the date of your visa application.
entry.es: Pakistán exige que tu pasaporte caduque al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de tu solicitud de visado.
entry.quote: To enter Pakistan, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date of your visa application.

entry.en: Get your passport stamped on entry, because leaving Pakistan will be difficult without an entry stamp.
entry.es: Haz que sellen tu pasaporte a la entrada, porque salir de Pakistán será difícil sin sello de entrada.
entry.quote: Make sure you get your passport stamped on entry. Leaving Pakistan will be difficult if you do not have an entry stamp.

entry.en: You must have a certificate of yellow fever vaccination if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Debes tener un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si llegas de un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk

entry.en: Importing alcohol or pork products is illegal, and you could be detained if you try.
entry.es: Importar alcohol o productos de cerdo es ilegal y podrías ser detenido si lo intentas.
entry.quote: Importing alcohol or pork products is illegal. You could be detained if you try to import them.

entry.en: Entering Pakistan illegally is a serious offence, and without the correct documentation you may be detained or deported.
entry.es: Entrar ilegalmente en Pakistán es un delito grave y, sin la documentación correcta, podrías ser detenido o deportado.
entry.quote: Illegal entry to Pakistan is a serious offence. If you enter without the correct documentation you may be detained or deported.

entry.en: Travellers may experience enhanced screening and preventive measures, including testing, on entry to Pakistan.
entry.es: Los viajeros pueden pasar controles reforzados y medidas preventivas, incluidas pruebas, al entrar en Pakistán.
entry.quote: travellers may experience enhanced screening and preventive measures, including testing, on entry to Pakistan.

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Pakistan.
safety.es: Es muy probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Pakistán.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Pakistan.

safety.en: The UK government advises against all travel to Balochistan Province.
safety.es: El gobierno británico desaconseja todo viaje a la provincia de Baluchistán.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to Balochistan Province.

safety.en: Advance permission from local or federal authorities is needed to travel in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan and several districts in Azad Kashmir.
safety.es: Se necesita permiso previo de las autoridades locales o federales para viajar a Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Baluchistán y varios distritos de Azad Cachemira.
safety.quote: You must obtain advance permission from local or federal authorities to travel in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP), Balochistan and several districts in Azad Kashmir.

safety.en: Political rallies, protests and demonstrations may take place across the country and can start with little warning.
safety.es: Pueden producirse mítines, protestas y manifestaciones políticas en todo el país y pueden comenzar con poco aviso.
safety.quote: Political rallies, protests and demonstrations may take place across the country and can start with little warning.

safety.en: Street crime is a risk, particularly in crowded areas.
safety.es: El delito callejero es un riesgo, sobre todo en zonas concurridas.
safety.quote: Street crime is a risk, particularly in crowded areas.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity between men is illegal, and there are occasional arrests.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre hombres del mismo sexo es ilegal y hay detenciones ocasionales.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity between men is illegal. There are occasional arrests

health.en: Visitors are strongly advised not to drink tap water, which contains many impurities.
health.es: Se aconseja encarecidamente a los visitantes no beber agua del grifo, que contiene muchas impurezas.
health.quote: Visitors are strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water, which contains many impurities

health.en: Take precautions against dengue fever and malaria, both spread by mosquitoes.
health.es: Toma precauciones contra el dengue y la malaria, ambos transmitidos por mosquitos.
health.quote: Take precautions against dengue fever and malaria, both spread by mosquitoes.

health.en: You should provide proof of polio vaccination if asked by a vaccination team.
health.es: Debes presentar prueba de vacunación contra la polio si te la pide un equipo de vacunación.
health.quote: You should provide proof of polio vaccination if asked by a vaccination team.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Pakistan, including Gilgit-Baltistan.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas zonas de Pakistán, incluida Gilgit-Baltistán.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Pakistan, including Gilgit-Baltistan.

health.en: Air pollution is a health hazard in Pakistan, especially in the winter months from October to February.
health.es: La contaminación del aire es un riesgo para la salud en Pakistán, sobre todo en los meses de invierno, de octubre a febrero.
health.quote: Air pollution is a health hazard in Pakistan, especially during the winter months from October to February.

health.en: Check that you have travel insurance appropriate for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.
health.es: Comprueba que tienes un seguro de viaje adecuado para tratamiento local o evacuación médica inesperada.
health.quote: you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation

help.en: Emergency numbers in Pakistan are 1122 for ambulance and fire and 15 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Pakistán son el 1122 para ambulancia y bomberos y el 15 para la policía.

help.en: In remote or mountainous regions an ambulance could take over an hour due to poor road access and limited availability.
help.es: En regiones remotas o montañosas una ambulancia podría tardar más de una hora por el mal acceso por carretera y la escasa disponibilidad.
help.quote: In remote or mountainous regions it could take over an hour due to poor road access and limited ambulance availability.

getting_in.en: Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad are the main gateways to Pakistan by air.
getting_in.es: Karachi, Lahore e Islamabad son las principales puertas de entrada aérea a Pakistán.
getting_in.quote: Karachi, Lahore, and Islamabad are the main gateways to Pakistan by air.

getting_in.en: Nine other international airports are in Quetta, Peshawar, Sialkot, Multan, Faisalabad, Gawadar, Rahim Yar Khan, Dera Ghazi Khan and Skardu.
getting_in.es: Otros nueve aeropuertos internacionales están en Quetta, Peshawar, Sialkot, Multan, Faisalabad, Gawadar, Rahim Yar Khan, Dera Ghazi Khan y Skardu.
getting_in.quote: Nine other international airports are in Quetta, Peshawar, Sialkot, Multan, Faisalabad, Gawadar, Rahim Yar Khan, Dera Ghazi Khan and Skardu.

getting_in.en: The Khunjerab Pass, the only official land border crossing between Pakistan and China, is on the Karakoram Highway and is open to foreign tourists.
getting_in.es: El paso de Khunjerab, único cruce terrestre oficial entre Pakistán y China, está en la autopista del Karakórum y está abierto a turistas extranjeros.
getting_in.quote: The Khunjerab Pass, the only official land border crossing between Pakistan and China, is located on the Karakoram Highway and is open to foreign tourists.

getting_in.en: The Khunjerab Pass is open seasonally, typically from April to November, but can close at very short notice due to severe weather.
getting_in.es: El paso de Khunjerab abre por temporada, normalmente de abril a noviembre, pero puede cerrar con muy poco aviso por mal tiempo.
getting_in.quote: It is open seasonally, typically from April to November, but can close at very short notice due to severe weather conditions

getting_in.en: The Wagah crossing is the only official land crossing between Pakistan and India, but it is currently closed.
getting_in.es: El paso de Wagah es el único cruce terrestre oficial entre Pakistán e India, pero actualmente está cerrado.
getting_in.quote: The Wagah border crossing on the Grand Trunk Road is the only official land crossing between the two countries, but it is currently closed.

getting_in.en: All borders with Afghanistan can close at short notice.
getting_in.es: Todas las fronteras con Afganistán pueden cerrarse con poco aviso.
getting_in.quote: All borders with Afghanistan can close at short notice.

getting_around.en: PIA is the only airline serving Chitral, Gilgit and Skardu, the northern airports of interest to trekkers and climbers.
getting_around.es: PIA es la única aerolínea que sirve Chitral, Gilgit y Skardu, los aeropuertos del norte de interés para senderistas y escaladores.
getting_around.quote: Pakistan International Airlines (PIA) serves numerous domestic destinations and is the only airline to serve the three airports in the north of interest to trekkers or climbers: Chitral, Gilgit, and Skardu.

getting_around.en: There are usually two flights a day from Islamabad to those northern cities, but they are often cancelled due to bad weather.
getting_around.es: Suele haber dos vuelos diarios de Islamabad a esas ciudades del norte, pero a menudo se cancelan por mal tiempo.
getting_around.quote: There are usually two flights from Islamabad to these cities daily, but they are often cancelled due to bad weather

getting_around.en: Pakistan's rail network is widely considered to be one of the world's highest risk networks due to systemic issues.
getting_around.es: La red ferroviaria de Pakistán se considera ampliamente una de las de mayor riesgo del mundo por problemas sistémicos.
getting_around.quote: Pakistan’s rail network is widely considered to be one of the world’s highest risk networks due to systemic issues.

getting_around.en: A large portion of travel between Pakistani cities is by bus, which is often the cheapest and most convenient option.
getting_around.es: Gran parte de los viajes entre ciudades de Pakistán se hace en autobús, que suele ser la opción más barata y cómoda.
getting_around.quote: A large portion of travel between cities in Pakistan is carried out by bus. Travel by bus is often the cheapest and most convenient alternative.

getting_around.en: Daewoo runs a regular bus service between several major cities with air-conditioned buses and seats booked one day ahead.
getting_around.es: Daewoo ofrece un servicio regular de autobuses entre varias ciudades importantes, con aire acondicionado y asientos reservados con un día de antelación.
getting_around.quote: The Daewoo company runs a regular bus service between several major cities, with air-conditioned buses and seats booked one day ahead.

getting_around.en: Traffic in Pakistan drives on the left, and the traffic culture is very different from the West.
getting_around.es: En Pakistán se conduce por la izquierda y la cultura del tráfico es muy distinta de la occidental.
getting_around.quote: In Pakistan, traffic drives on the left; the traffic culture is very different from the West.

money.en: The national currency of Pakistan is the Pakistani rupee (Rs, ISO code PKR).
money.es: La moneda nacional de Pakistán es la rupia pakistaní (Rs, código ISO PKR).
money.quote: The national currency of Pakistan is the Pakistani rupee, denoted as Rs (ISO code PKR).

money.en: ATMs exist in most areas but only very few accept international cards such as American Express, MasterCard and Visa.
money.es: Hay cajeros en la mayoría de zonas, pero muy pocos aceptan tarjetas internacionales como American Express, MasterCard y Visa.
money.quote: ATMs exist in most areas but only very few accept international cards such as American Express, MasterCard and Visa.

money.en: It is always good to carry small bills, as merchants and drivers sometimes have no change.
money.es: Conviene llevar siempre billetes pequeños, pues comerciantes y conductores a veces no tienen cambio.
money.quote: It is always good to have a number of small bills on hand, as merchants and drivers sometimes have no change.

money.en: Small businesses and family-run stores almost never accept credit cards.
money.es: Los pequeños negocios y tiendas familiares casi nunca aceptan tarjetas de crédito.
money.quote: Small businesses and family-run stores almost never accept credit cards

money.en: You are expected to negotiate the price with street hawkers but not in department stores.
money.es: Se espera que regatees el precio con los vendedores ambulantes, pero no en los grandes almacenes.
money.quote: In Pakistan, you are expected to negotiate the price with street hawkers but not in department stores.

money.en: Tipping is considered good practice, and porters, taxi drivers and delivery men appreciate a small tip for exemplary service.
money.es: Dar propina se considera buena práctica y porteros, taxistas y repartidores agradecen una pequeña propina por un servicio ejemplar.
money.quote: Tipping is considered a good practice in Pakistan. Hotel porters, taxi drivers, delivery men will appreciate a small tip if you have been provided with exemplary service.

etiquette.en: Remove your shoes when entering a religious building.
etiquette.es: Quítate los zapatos al entrar en un edificio religioso.
etiquette.quote: Remember to remove your shoes when entering a religious building.

etiquette.en: Use your right hand for eating, shaking hands and giving or receiving everything, and reserve your left hand for shoes and toilet duties.
etiquette.es: Usa la mano derecha para comer, saludar y dar o recibir cualquier cosa, y reserva la izquierda para los zapatos y el aseo.
etiquette.quote: Use your right hand for eating, shaking hands and giving or receiving everything (including money), and reserve your left hand for handling shoes and assisting in toilet duties.

etiquette.en: Men should never shake hands with or touch a woman they do not know very well.
etiquette.es: Los hombres nunca deben estrechar la mano ni tocar a una mujer que no conocen bien.
etiquette.quote: Men should never shake hands with or touch a woman they don't know very well.

etiquette.en: Pakistani people generally dress conservatively, although more liberal attire can be seen in metropolitan cities.
etiquette.es: Los pakistaníes suelen vestir de forma conservadora, aunque en las grandes ciudades se ve vestimenta más liberal.
etiquette.quote: Pakistani people generally dress conservatively, although in metropolitan cities more liberal attire can be seen.

etiquette.en: Discussion about religion should always remain respectful and positive.
etiquette.es: Las conversaciones sobre religión deben ser siempre respetuosas y positivas.
etiquette.quote: Discussion about religion should always remain respectful and positive

etiquette.en: Insulting or showing disrespect or contempt of religion or anything considered holy (blasphemy) is illegal.
etiquette.es: Insultar o mostrar falta de respeto o desprecio hacia la religión o lo considerado sagrado (blasfemia) es ilegal.
etiquette.quote: Insulting or showing disrespect or contempt of religion, religious beliefs or anything considered holy (blasphemy) is illegal.

connectivity.en: All Pakistani cellular operators use the GSM platform, so handsets are freely interchangeable between providers.
connectivity.es: Todos los operadores móviles de Pakistán usan la plataforma GSM, por lo que los teléfonos son intercambiables entre proveedores.
connectivity.quote: One very convenient feature is that all Pakistani cellular operators use the GSM platform, so that cellular handsets nationwide are freely interchangeable between providers.

connectivity.en: Mobile service providers include Onic, Jazz, Telenor, Ufone and Zong (China Mobile).
connectivity.es: Entre los proveedores de telefonía móvil están Onic, Jazz, Telenor, Ufone y Zong (China Mobile).
connectivity.quote: Among them are Onic, Jazz, Telenor, Ufone, & Zong (China Mobile).

connectivity.en: A cheap phone usually costs about Rs 2,000 and a prepaid connection Rs 150-400, and you should bring your passport and visa.
connectivity.es: Un teléfono barato suele costar unas Rs 2.000 y una conexión de prepago Rs 150-400, y debes llevar tu pasaporte y tu visado.
connectivity.quote: you can usually get a new cheap cell phone just for Rs 2,000 and a prepaid connection for Rs 150-400. Bring your passport and your visa!

connectivity.en: There are Wi-Fi hotspots all over Pakistan, in hotels, malls, cafes and restaurants.
connectivity.es: Hay puntos wifi por todo Pakistán, en hoteles, centros comerciales, cafés y restaurantes.
connectivity.quote: There are Wi-Fi hotspots all over Pakistan, in hotels, malls, and cafes/restaurants.

connectivity.en: During protests or civil unrest, mobile data coverage and internet connectivity may be cut without warning.
connectivity.es: Durante protestas o disturbios, la cobertura de datos móviles y la conexión a internet pueden cortarse sin aviso.
connectivity.quote: During times of protest or civil unrest, mobile data coverage and internet connectivity may be cut without warning.

connectivity.en: The country code for Pakistan is +92 when calling from outside the country.
connectivity.es: El prefijo de Pakistán es +92 si llamas desde fuera del país.
connectivity.quote: The country code for Pakistan is +92 if you are calling from outside the country.
